name: data-relational-database
description: Use when the user asks about PostgreSQL or MySQL indexing, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, partitioning, streaming or logical replication, autovacuum, connection pooling (PgBouncer) or query optimization. Produces index, partition, replication and pooling configs. Not for engine theory such as MVCC internals (use database-internals-mechanics) or sharding (use architecture-database-scaling).
